problem: Employee referrals are the best hiring channel but are hard to run, so StrongIntro automates outreach through employees' networks with human assistance.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus service (listing shows 49 dollars per month in a later directory)

founders.name: Fouad Matin
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder and CEO of StrongIntro (later Indent). A fan archive says he joined Segment in August 2016; single weak source, unverified.

technical_complexity.rationale: Network analysis and outreach automation on top of social and professional data; standard software.

defensibility.rationale: Referral tooling was copyable by ATS vendors and sourcing tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Greenhouse and Lever ship basic built in referral features per later vendor comparisons; dated 2016 evidence not found.

market_need_then: YC launch post says employee referrals are prized for culture, retention and speed of hiring.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found beyond the YC launch post and a Product Hunt listing.

outcome_analysis: StrongIntro was a two person referral recruiting tool in YC Winter 2016 that raised about 120 thousand dollars from YC. A fan built archive says the founders chose to wind down rather than pivot into a business they had not set out to build, but this is a single weak source and no official cause was found, so failure factors are left empty.
notes: Seed rests on CB Insights (March 21 2016); the fan archive says Demo Day around March 23. A Product Hunt comment credits Tieshun Roquerre with building the product, but no company source calls him co-founder so he is not listed. strongintro.com returned HTTP 503 (down or dead). Competitor list empty: only 2023 or later comparison pages found. Wind-down detail is unverified.
